### Fixed
- **The marketing-email language finding no longer overstates its case.** When a
  portal declares one language under two codes, the report said the code without
  a translation shows its preference centre and unsubscribe text in the portal
  default. That only holds if the subscription is actually translated into that
  language: where nothing is translated, both codes fall back to the same text
  and nothing is mis-rendering. The report now distinguishes the two, and where
  nothing is translated it says so plainly while flagging the split as a tidy-up
  that becomes a real defect the moment a translation is added for one code.
  Found by running the check against a portal with 30 such emails and no
  translations at all, where the old wording condemned a correct setup.
